architecture.owner: Nupp owns instruction decoding, logical frame windows, arithmetic, bounds, transfers and result packing. Semantic optimization belongs in the existing Nupp graph; CLIF emission remains mechanical.

handlerCoverage.guard: Every Op has a non-Slow encoding and every non-Slow Code has a linked Nupp export. Exhaustive Rust encoding match rejects new unencoded Op variants. This does not prove conditional fallback deletion.

architecture.counts: Source callsite counts, not runtime profiles or proof of Rust execution removal.
architecture.modulesAndMethods: Require/RequireV/SetMethod use Nupp operands and windows. Named managed services retain module loader/cache/cycle/error policy and method storage/epoch bookkeeping.
architecture.numeric: Nupp owns exact wrapping integer exponentiation, floor division, floating operations, integer/unsigned boxes, tag tests, scalar widths and unsigned branches. Named services retain operand coercion/metamethod invocation, allocation, errors and primitive powf. Existing numeric semantics are preserved; the separate language number-model migration is open.
architecture.bytes: Nupp owns carrier classification, bounds/clamps, loads/stores, substring and short-string interning. Narrow storage services retain managed allocation, alias-safe append growth/accounting, buffer ownership/consumption and exact errors.
architecture.state: Nupp owns last-matching Disarm, Checkpoint sequencing, Park resume PC and VarargTable trimming/copy/barriers. Task, affine and GC storage policy remain named managed services for P4/P3.
architecture.callsAndReturns: CallT uses the shared Nupp frame policy and logical float/value arguments; FRet uses logical float slots and exact number canonicalization. Ret/RetNil/RetN/PadResults have no native.slow branch. Overlap-safe packs retain up to255 results and reload windows after collecting cleanup. Named services retain task completion, protection and cleanup policy.
architecture.cleanupCorrection: The preexisting Rust and native cleanup service could overwrite live large-result tails. Four regressions fail on the old service and pass after saving, rooting and restoring the explicit tail/count around callbacks. Suspended cleanup uses the existing ordinary serialized unwind table; snapshot format is unchanged.
architecture.graphBoundary: Eight handlers currently use the existing common graph. The remaining direct lowering is named P1b deletion debt. No CLIF optimizer, Rust guest emitter or dependencies were added.
architecture.remaining: 50 conditional native.slow source callsites in seven modules, exhausted-budget/capacity and special arithmetic/table/metamethod/control paths, existing Rust step/compiled boundaries, temporary managed services, number model, cold-bootstrap platform runtime/image pairs and full native CLI/corpus acceptance remain open.
